description: From the fz-k22 STOP-and-report investigation. project_executable_input_source (src/compiler2/jobs/transport.rs:2839-2857) callable branch: when 2+ distinct producer shapes satisfy the callable demand it records boundary/publication facts for the multiple source_shapes but then FALLS THROUGH to a non-callable equality check that fails (shapes differ) -> yields SourceShape::Unknown, never returning the generic boxed callable shape (function:None, one ValueRef lane) the codebase already uses for the ambiguous/opaque-closure case (doc at transport.rs:3414-3423). Looks like half-wired dead code from a partial multi-producer boundary mechanism -- finish it. FIX (VERIFIED WORKING IN ISOLATION by the investigation, small/localized, reuses generic_callable_shape): fall back to generic_callable_shape when exact_len>=2 / source_shapes_len>=2 at a callable position. NOTE: this fix ALONE does NOT turn the repro green (the crash persists byte-identical) -- the proximate cause is Slice C; B is a required correctness piece that must land WITH A+C. Related: fz-k22.

comments.text: Folded at 15d6ae750. project_executable_input_source's ambiguous multi-producer callable branch (transport.rs ~2853) now returns Exact(generic_callable_shape(...)) instead of falling through to SourceShape::Unknown -- fixing the source-of-truth transport shape that slices .1/.3 build on. Adversarial audit CLEAN (no MUST-FIX): generic_callable_shape is the single uniform opaque-closure representation (function:None, one ValueRef lane), the branch fires ONLY for genuinely-distinct producers (same-shape ones deduped earlier by extend_unique/ShapeId equality), shape is ty-invariant. Confirmed no-op OBSERVABLY today (both production consumers -- collect_executable_input_constraints and project_source's ExecutableInput dispatch -- already fell back to generic_callable_shape with identical ty/demand/facts/publication), verified non-vacuous via HEAD~1 worktree. No regression (matrix 352/11, enum_predicate_search STAYS red as EXPECTED -- crash needs .3). AUDIT CORRECTION of the impl agent's 'redundant fallback, just delete it' framing: those two fallback sites remain LOAD-BEARING for OTHER legit Unknown causes (empty sources, missing context, empty admitted-shapes) -- only the ambiguous-2+-producer path is now closed, not the fallbacks. lib 1274/0/6, clippy+fmt clean.

title: fz-k22 Slice B: project_executable_input_source returns generic boxed callable shape (not SourceShape::Unknown) for ambiguous multi-producer callable
